# DataBridge Local File Workbench

> A lightweight, 100% offline desktop application for Windows and macOS to batch convert files and merge messy Excel/CSV spreadsheets without uploading sensitive data to the cloud.

## Core Value Proposition
- **100% Local Processing**: All file conversions and spreadsheet operations run locally on the user's device. Zero files are uploaded to external servers (ideal for NDA, financial, and supplier data).
- **Platform Support**: Windows (Installer & Portable v1.1.2+) and macOS (DMG v1.1.2+).
- **Pricing**: Free tier for core batch conversions; Pro tier at $12.99/month via Paddle for advanced multi-file Excel merging and data cleaning.

## Key Pages
- [Home & Download](https://durian9188-jpg.github.io/databridge-website/): Official download links for Windows and macOS.
- [FAQ - Offline File & Excel Processing](https://durian9188-jpg.github.io/databridge-website/faq.html): Detailed answers on supported formats, privacy, pricing, and system requirements.
- [DataBridge vs. Online Converters](https://durian9188-jpg.github.io/databridge-website/vs-online-converters.html): Comparison between local desktop processing and cloud-based tools like Smallpdf or CloudConvert.

## Supported Use Cases
1. Merging multiple supplier Excel (.xlsx) and CSV files with inconsistent column headers locally.
2. Batch converting images (JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, ICO) offline.
3. Converting audio and video formats locally on Mac and Windows.
4. Converting Markdown (.md) notes and AI-generated text into clean Word (.docx) documents.
